scope: Final Windows update compatibility and endpoint safety checks

tests.name: test_accounts_updates.AccountsTests.test_update_starts_with_active_api_requests_and_closes_after_preparation
tests.behavior: Update starts with three active API requests, preparation is called once, duplicate application is rejected, and the window closes only after successful preparation.

tests.name: test_audit_fred.AuditTests.test_endpoint_change_is_blocked_during_active_api_requests
tests.behavior: Endpoint change is refused during an active API request and the endpoint remains unchanged.

source_changes: Remote.update restored to its original behavior; obsolete audit narrowed and renamed to cover endpoint changes; Android unchanged.
